name: ui-ux-next-audit
description: Read-only UI/UX consistency audit for frontend projects. Establishes a baseline against React 19 + Ant Design 6, scans tokens/components/states, writes a structured report to the project root, and emits grouped fix prompts for repair agents.

install.note: Agent loads SKILL.md when the user asks for a UI/UX audit.
